Create Contact.description: Creates a contact, e.g. a donor or volunteer captured from a sign-up form.

Create Organization.description: Creates an organization (Accounts module), such as a partner NGO or funder.

Create Lead.description: Creates a lead, e.g. a prospective partner from an event registration.

Partially Update Record.description: Changes only the given fields on an existing record (revise).

Replace Record.description: Fully replaces a record (update); send all mandatory fields.

Create Contacts In Bulk.description: Creates one contact for each item in a list.

List Module Types.description: Lists the modules (element types) the user can access, e.g. to check module names before writing.
